edges.reason: Player must first ensure survival before exploring forward to locate the grass path junction
The grass path junction at Z=8 branches left toward the flower garden where blue orchids are placed
The grass path junction at Z=8 branches right toward the materials depot
The grass path continues forward from the junction to the solid terracotta wall at Z=13-15
The grindstone at (-9,1,10) is located past the orchid cluster; player navigates through orchids to reach it
Green concrete powder at (8-9,0,9) is positioned behind light blue concrete powder; player passes light blue to discover green
After mining through terracotta wall, player encounters green concrete powder blocking the corridor at Z=16
Green concrete powder physically blocks corridor at Z=16; mining it reveals red nether brick stairs at Z=17-18

milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box to verify the player has navigated forward into the play area while remaining alive. The box starts at Z=6 (requiring meaningful forward movement from spawn at Z=0) and covers the exploration zone. This avoids trivial satisfaction at spawn since the player must walk at least 6 blocks forward. Chosen because the evaluator has no direct 'is_alive' rule type, so forward navigation proves the player is alive and active.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dirt_path junction is at (0,0,8) where the path branches left, right, and forward. Target at (0,0,8) requires 8 blocks of navigation from spawn. Max_distance=3 ensures the player must be within the junction area. Facing_tolerance=90 is generous since the path extends in multiple directions from the junction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue orchids are placed at (-7,0,8) and (-8,0,8) in the left branch flower garden. Player must navigate to the flower garden area and face toward the orchids. Distance from junction (0,0,8) to target (-7,0,8) is 7 blocks > max_distance of 5, so this cannot be accidentally triggered from the junction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Light blue concrete powder blocks are at (7-8, 0, 8-9) in the right branch materials depot. Player must navigate to the depot and face toward the blocks. Distance from junction to target is 7 blocks > max_distance of 5, requiring intentional navigation to the right branch.

Uses inventory_has because mining red terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player has a wooden pickaxe which is sufficient to mine terracotta. The terracotta wall at Z=13-15 is the first barrier in the forward corridor and is not in the starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the evaluator has no direct 'use_block' rule type. The grindstone is at (-9,1,10) on a stone support block. Max_distance=2 ensures the player is within right-click interaction range (arm's reach), and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking directly at the grindstone. This is the best available approximation of actual interaction given evaluator constraints. Documented limitation: does not verify actual GUI opening.

Uses inventory_has because mining green concrete powder drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. Concrete powder can be mined with any tool or by hand and always drops itself. The player encounters green concrete powder both in the right-branch depot (8-9,0,9) and as the corridor barrier wall at Z=16. Mining the corridor barrier is required to progress toward the trapped chest. Not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick stairs with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. Red nether brick stairs require a pickaxe to drop (the player has a wooden pickaxe which is sufficient). These stairs form the final barrier at Z=17-18 before the trapped chest. Not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The trapped chest is at (0,0,19) behind three sequential barriers enclosed in stone bricks. The stone_bricks enclosure (walls at X=-2 and X=2, ceiling at Y=3, stone floor at Y=-1 from Z=13-19) prevents reaching this position without mining through all barriers. Max_distance=3 ensures the player has physically reached the end of the corridor and is facing the chest.

scene_description: A compact exploration area with a dirt path branching from spawn to three zones. The forward corridor to the trapped chest is physically blocked by three sequential barriers enclosed in stone bricks with an anti-tunneling stone floor: red terracotta wall (Z=13-15), green concrete powder blockage (Z=16), and red nether brick stairs (Z=17-18). The left branch has blue orchids leading to a grindstone. The right branch has light blue concrete powder with green concrete powder behind it. All dependencies are physically enforced.
task_text: Survive and explore the pathways ahead. Follow the dirt path to discover three zones: a flower garden with a grindstone, a materials depot with colored powders, and a blocked corridor. Mine through the terracotta wall, concrete powder blockage, and nether brick stairs to reach the trapped chest at the end.
design_notes: Final confirmed layout: Player spawns at origin facing +Z. Dirt path runs Z=1-12 with junction at Z=8 branching left (orchids X=-7/-8, grindstone X=-9 Z=10) and right (light blue concrete X=7/8, green concrete X=8/9 Z=9). Forward corridor Z=13-19 enclosed in stone_bricks (walls X=±2, ceiling Y=3) with stone floor (Y=-1, anti-tunneling). Three sequential barriers: red terracotta Z=13-15, green concrete powder Z=16, red nether brick stairs Z=17-18. Trapped chest at (0,0,19) placed after back wall to override. Command order ensures: (1) terrain first, (2) path second, (3) decorations, (4) corridor structure (floor→walls→ceiling→barriers→back wall→chest), (5) player items last.
